title: SRE: dashboards + alerts for marketplace entitlement lag, webhook failures, provisioning error rate (define thresholds)
creator: Talia Benson
description: Add dashboards + actionable alerts for the marketplace purchase→entitlement→org-linking→provisioning pipeline. Specifically: entitlement activation lag, webhook ingestion failures (AWS + GCP), and provisioning error rate. Define thresholds that catch real buyer-impacting issues without paging on normal marketplace delay variance. Provide links/runbook notes for Support + SRE escalation during listing launch.
acceptance_criteria:
- Dashboard exists and is discoverable from SRE/Marketplace folder with clear AWS vs GCP breakdowns.
- Alerts exist for: (1) entitlement lag, (2) webhook ingestion failures, (3) provisioning error rate, (4) sudden drop in webhook volume (signal of upstream/credentials issue).
- Each alert includes: severity, threshold, evaluation window, suggested first checks, and owner/on-call routing.
- Alert thresholds reviewed with Eng (Ethan Park / Cole Summers) and Support (Dev Patel) and documented in ticket.
- Runbook link added to each alert and pinned in #marketplace-oncall.
implementation_notes:
Observability implementation uses the new metrics emitted by provisioning pipeline instrumentation (see PR references below). Dashboards + alerts are implemented in observability-pack so they are versioned and deployed consistently across environments.

Key design notes:
- Separate “marketplace delay” from “Redwood delay”: entitlement_lag measures time from marketplace event receipt (webhook timestamp) → entitlement mapped/active in Redwood; we do not page based solely on marketplace-side purchase-to-event delay.
- Break down by cloud provider (aws|gcp), environment (prod|staging), sku_family (hosted|dedicated|private|addon), and failure_type.
- Prefer rate-based alerts (error ratio) over absolute counts for webhook/provisioning failures, plus a low-volume guard to avoid flapping.
- Idempotency/retries: alert on sustained failures AFTER retries, not first-attempt failures. We use “final_failure” counters where available.
alert_thresholds:
Proposed + implemented thresholds (prod):

1) Entitlement lag (webhook_received→entitlement_active)
- Metric: marketplace_entitlement_lag_seconds
- Alert: p95 > 300s for 15m (SEV2) ; p95 > 900s for 10m (SEV1)
- Notes: excludes events missing required identifiers (these count under mapping failures).

2) Webhook ingestion failures (validated webhooks)
- Metric: marketplace_webhook_ingest_requests_total{status}
- Alert: error_ratio(status=5xx or validation_failed) > 1% for 10m AND total_requests > 50 (SEV2)
- Alert: error_ratio > 5% for 5m AND total_requests > 50 (SEV1)
- Companion: webhook_volume_drop: total_requests < 5 over 15m during business hours (SEV2) to catch credential/endpoint/partner-side issues.

3) Provisioning error rate (entitlement→org linking/activation)
- Metric: marketplace_provisioning_attempts_total{result}
- Alert: failure_ratio(result=error) > 0.5% for 15m AND attempts > 100 (SEV2)
- Alert: failure_ratio > 2% for 10m AND attempts > 50 (SEV1)

4) Stuck entitlements backlog
- Metric: marketplace_entitlements_pending_gauge
- Alert: pending > 25 for 30m (SEV3) ; pending > 100 for 15m (SEV2)

Routing:
- SEV1 pages SRE on-call; SEV2 posts to #marketplace-oncall and creates incident ticket; SEV3 posts to #marketplace-support-internal with SRE + Eng triage tag.

Environments:
- Staging thresholds are less strict and non-paging (Slack only) to avoid noise during QA.
dashboard_panels:
Dashboard: “Marketplace Onboarding Health (AWS/GCP)” panels:
- Overview: total webhook volume (aws vs gcp), error ratio, and p95 entitlement lag.
- Entitlement Lag: p50/p95/p99 lag seconds; heatmap; top SKUs by lag; region breakdown.
- Webhook Ingestion: request rate, 4xx vs 5xx breakdown, validation failures, signature verification failures.
- Provisioning: attempts vs successes vs failures; error types (org_not_linked, region_mismatch, sku_unknown, billing_meter_error, internal_exception).
- Backlog: pending entitlements gauge; age of oldest pending entitlement.
- Buyer Journey Funnel (best-effort): webhook_received → entitlement_mapped → entitlement_active → org_linked → first_successful_api_call (uses existing console/backend events where available).
- Drilldowns: links to logs (request_id / entitlement_id) and traces for failed provisioning operations.
runbook_links:
Runbook notes embedded in each alert (high level):
- Check recent deploys/feature flags: marketplace onboarding flag + provisioning worker changes (ENG-4408 rollout plan).
- Validate partner endpoints: confirm marketplace webhook endpoints returning 2xx; check TLS/rotation changes.
- Check mapping layer: unknown SKU spikes usually indicate stale SKU mapping sheet / missing entitlement IDs (ENG-4401/ENG-4406).
- For lag: inspect queue depth and worker health; check database latency; verify retries not stuck due to idempotency lock.
- For region mismatch failures: confirm Mina Haddad’s routing/residency rules; check GCP region constraints and docs.

Pointers:
- #marketplace-oncall (Slack) escalation channel
- Internal: “Marketplace Provisioning & Troubleshooting Guide” (CS/Support) is the primary step-by-step reference; alerts link directly to the ‘Entitlement delays’ and ‘Webhook failures’ sections.
